signature.name: VTask.greatestOfBdd
signature.type: {P : ℤ → Prop} -> [DecidablePred P] -> (b : ℤ) -> (Hb : ∀ (z : ℤ), P z → z ≤ b) -> (Hinh : ∃ z, P z) -> { ub // P ub ∧ ∀ (z : ℤ), P z → z ≤ ub }

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: The function is total on its (proof-constrained) domain; the hypotheses Hb and Hinh eliminate all degenerate inputs, so no junk-value conventions arise.

facts.statement: ∀ (P : ℤ → Prop) [DecidablePred P] (b b' : ℤ) (Hb : ∀ z : ℤ, P z → z ≤ b) (Hb' : ∀ z : ℤ, P z → z ≤ b') (Hinh : ∃ z : ℤ, P z), (VTask.greatestOfBdd b Hb Hinh : ℤ) = (VTask.greatestOfBdd b' Hb' Hinh : ℤ)
